_OBJECTIVE: Verify that target RCS directly affects fusionRadarSensor detection probability. A 20 dBsm airliner must produce measurably more detections per scan than a -10 dBsm stealth UAV from the same radar under clear weather.
_PASS_CRITERIA: Detection count for 20 dBsm target > 2x detection count for -10 dBsm target at comparable range.
_NOTE: Unlike frequency (metadata only), RCS is a first-class sensor property via platform.Signatures = rcsSignature.
description: TC-05: RCS demo — Boeing 737 (20 dBsm) vs Stealth UAV (-10 dBsm), clear weather
